nodes.description: Context._msgSender() internal view returns msg.sender; the only source of caller identity used by access control.
Context._msgData() internal view returns calldata msg.data; unused by the business logic.
Ownable._owner: private address holding the privileged owner account; mutated by constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Ownable.owner() view returns _owner; used by the onlyOwner modifier, by receive() for QANX allowance and as QANX source.
onlyOwner modifier: require(owner() == _msgSender()); the sole access-control gate for makeOffer, cancelOffer, claimPurchasePrice, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling all privileged functions.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner; reassigns _owner after a zero-address check.
IERC20L private _qanx = 0xAAA7A10a8ee237ea61E8AC46C50A8Db8bCC1baaa; external QANX token contract used for allowance, transferFrom and transferLocked.
IERC20 private _usdt = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7; external USDT token contract used for allowance, transferFrom, balanceOf and transfer.
mapping(address => Offer) public offers: per-buyer offer terms (qanxAmount, usdtAmount, claimableHours deadline, lock/hop settings); written by makeOffer, deleted by cancelOffer and receive.
makeOffer(...) public onlyOwner; scales amounts by token decimals and stores an Offer whose claimableHours is uint32(block.timestamp + _claimableHours * 3600).
cancelOffer(address _ofBuyer) public onlyOwner; deletes offers[_ofBuyer].
receive() external payable: validates zero ETH, offer deadline against block.timestamp, allowances, then performs four external token calls and finally deletes offers[_msgSender()].
claimPurchasePrice(address _beneficiary) public onlyOwner; forwards the full USDT balance of this contract to _beneficiary.
msg.sender (returned via _msgSender()): attacker-controlled caller used in onlyOwner, as the offer key in receive() and as the USDT transferFrom source.
block.timestamp: miner/validator-influenced value used to compute offer deadlines in makeOffer and to gate claims in receive().
_usdt.transferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), usdtAllowance): arbitrary external call to USDT executed inside receive() before the offer state is cleared.
_qanx.transferFrom(owner(), address(this), offers[_msgSender()].qanxAmount): external call pulling QANX from the owner into the contract during receive().
_qanx.transferLocked(_msgSender(), amount, hardLockUntil, softLockUntil, allowedHops): external call to a non-standard token with attacker-influenced arguments.
_usdt.transfer(_beneficiary, _usdt.balanceOf(address(this))): external call in claimPurchasePrice draining the full USDT balance.
delete offers[_msgSender()]: state update performed after all external token calls, enabling repeated claims if a token call re-enters receive().
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership; becomes _owner after the zero-address check.
address _toBuyer parameter of makeOffer; used as the mapping key of offers.
uint256 _qanxAmount parameter of makeOffer; scaled by 10**18 and stored as Offer.qanxAmount.
uint256 _usdtAmount parameter of makeOffer; scaled by 10**6 and stored as Offer.usdtAmount.
uint32 _claimableHours parameter of makeOffer; converted to an absolute deadline with block.timestamp.
uint32 _hardLockUntil parameter of makeOffer; forwarded to the QANX transferLocked call.
uint32 _softLockUntil parameter of makeOffer; forwarded to the QANX transferLocked call.
uint8 _allowedHops parameter of makeOffer; forwarded to the QANX transferLocked call.
address _ofBuyer parameter of cancelOffer; key of the offers entry being deleted.
address _beneficiary parameter of claimPurchasePrice; recipient of the drained USDT balance.
address msgSender local in the Ownable constructor; result of _msgSender() written into _owner.
uint256 qanxAllowance in receive(); _qanx.allowance(owner(), address(this)) checked against the offered QANX amount.
uint256 usdtAllowance in receive(); _usdt.allowance(_msgSender(), address(this)) required to equal the offer price and then transferred.

owner() returns the privileged _owner state variable used in the modifier.
receive() uses owner() as QANX allowance holder and as transferFrom source.
_toBuyer is used as the offers mapping key.
_claimableHours is turned into a block.timestamp-based offer deadline.
block.timestamp determines the offer claimable deadline (timestamp dependency).
the _usdt token instance is the target of the transfer.
_msgSender() is the buyer key read and deleted inside receive().
qanxAllowance local is derived from _qanx.allowance and checked in receive().
usdtAllowance local is compared with the offer price and transferred in receive().
receive() reads offers[_msgSender()] repeatedly and deletes it after external calls.

external QANX transferLocked is invoked before the offer state is cleared.
_qanx instance is the target of transferFrom.

_usdt instance is the target of transferFrom.

offer deletion happens after the QANX transferFrom external call.
offer deletion happens after the QANX transferLocked external call.
